# JSON dependency

nlohmann/json v3.12.0, MIT license (included in the installed headers).

Source: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.12.0

Run `tools/fetch_dependencies.py` from the browser component after installing
`requirements.txt`. The ignored `nlohmann/` directory is copied from the pinned
Python package; source headers are not duplicated in Git.
